Features.Title: Keep entering shift drops
Features.Description: After a successful shift drop save and the result message, the cursor returns to Shift / Batch Number. Previous entry values clear so you can enter the next batch without pressing Record Shift Drop again.

Features.Title: Keep entering cash payouts
Features.Description: After a successful payout save, the cursor returns to Payout Amount with the default value selected. Enter the next payout directly. This works in all three ledger layouts.
